card.name: Small linking words in legal explanations
card.fires_on: Small linking words (a, the, is, under, of, or, an) inside formal legal or official explanations, such as election law, property conveyancing and assessment rules. The word usually comes just before a legal noun phrase.

modes.label: Article or verb before legal term
modes.description: A, an, the or is just before a legal noun such as practice, powers or interest.
modes.example: Any expense in excess of Rs 25 lakhs amounts to<< a>> corrupt practice under sec 123

modes.label: Preposition or conjunction in legal reference
modes.description: Under, of or or linking to a statute, deed or document type.
modes.example: Refers to a promise contained within a Conveyance, Transfer<< or>> Deed.

card.writes: Weakly favors formal nouns like provision, consultancy and manifesto, which suggests an official or policy-style continuation.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in formal legal or official text, right before the legal term that comes next.
